intent: A feature-flag panel for a deployment console: each flag opens to environment switches, a rollout you drag, targeting rules that read as one sentence, a verdict for a named organisation, and a kill switch that asks once.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries; colours as CSS variables on the root (--ff-surface, --ff-well, --ff-raised, --ff-ink, --ff-muted, --ff-faint, --ff-line, --ff-line-strong, --ff-track, --ff-err, --ff-accent)
stack.animation: motion/react: variants for the entrance, height for the open flag, a spring for switch thumbs
stack.icons: none; the switches and slider are drawn in CSS
stack.fonts: font-sans (Geist) for names, sentences and buttons; font-mono (Geist Mono) for keys, percentages, the verdict and the owner line

layout.root: section, @container, max-width 920px, 20px radius, overflow hidden, padding 20px and 24px from @xl
layout.header: accent dot and project name left; flag count right
layout.list: well, 14px radius; one flag open; closed rows show the name, key, percentage and which environments are on
layout.detail: description, owner, three environment switches, rollout slider, targeting sentence with a switch per clause, verdict, kill switch
layout.environments: full-width rows below @lg; from @lg each label sits beside its switch and the three share one row
layout.kill: full-width Kill below @lg; from @lg the button sits at the end of the sentence

typography.sentence: Geist 13.5px, leading 1.55; the active clauses are ink

color.accent: #7cc4ff by default; the open flag’s edge, the rollout fill, and a served verdict
color.kill: the word Killed and the Kill label use the error colour; the confirm button is ink on the surface

motion.entrance: header and list rise 10px out of a 6px blur, 60ms apart, 560ms, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
motion.open: the detail grows over 320ms and closes in 180ms on ease-in
motion.switch: the thumb travels 16px on a spring, stiffness 500, damping 40
motion.reducedMotion: opacity only, 150ms or less; no blur, rise or spring

responsive.container: environment switches stack below @lg and sit in three columns from @lg; kill actions sit under the sentence below @lg
responsive.rows: the key truncates; the percentage stays on the right
responsive.overflow: nothing scrolls the page sideways; the slider uses touch-action pan-y so a drag does not scroll the page

accessibility: Each flag row is a button with aria-expanded
Environment and rule controls are switches with aria-checked
The rollout is a slider with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow, and arrow keys step by 5
Keyboard-only 2px ink focus rings; 44px targets below @lg

content.flags: New checkout at 25%, Invoice PDF at 100%, Usage forecast off in production, Strict idempotency in development only
content.sample: Northwind Ltd sits in rollout bucket 41, so 25% leaves them outside and about 80% serves them
content.kill: Kill asks once, then sets the rollout to 0 and turns every environment off; Undo restores the snapshot

avoid: a hue per environment or a tinted row
a modal for the kill switch
resetting every flag when the rollout control changes
